nonBlockingIssues.description: atlas.rs imports RasterizedGlyph via absolute path 'crate::text::rasterization::RasterizedGlyph' while other cross-module references use 'super::*'. A 'use super::rasterization::RasterizedGlyph;' would be more consistent.
Orphaned 'Z-Index Management' section comment — methods moved to z_index.rs but comment remains. Should be removed or replaced with pointer to submodule.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document in split-worker skill that: (1) When a feature description says to keep an inline module alongside a file-based module with the same name, the file-based approach takes precedence since Rust doesn't allow both. (2) When extracting tests would cause mod.rs to exceed the line target, extracting tests to a tests.rs file via #[path = "tests.rs"] is a valid approach.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: split-context worker encountered both situations: z_index module couldn't stay inline (Rust restriction), and keeping tests in mod.rs would have exceeded 800-line target (1,256 lines).

rejectedObservations.observation: Worker added set_font_scale and scaled_font_size to frame.rs beyond the feature description scope
rejectedObservations.reason: This is a sensible implementation detail — these methods are frame-lifecycle-related and belong in frame.rs. The feature description was incomplete, not the implementation wrong.
